summary.zh: 本次更新新增了应用内查看 GitHub Actions 工作流运行日志的能力，按构建步骤分节展示，无需跳出应用。
summary.en: This update adds an in-app viewer for GitHub Actions workflow run logs, organized per build step, without leaving the app.

items.zh: 工作流运行详情页新增“查看日志”入口，应用内直接阅读 Actions 构建日志
items.en: New log viewer entry on workflow run detail pages to read Actions logs in-app

items.zh: 日志按 Job 和构建步骤分节折叠展示，支持关键字定位
items.en: Logs are grouped per job and build step with collapsible sections

items.zh: 修复日志页面滚动状态的一处状态委托问题
items.en: Fixed a state delegation issue in the log viewer scroll state
